title: hyparrhenia foliosa
intro: Hyparrhenia foliosa, commonly known as Pappas grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hyparrhenia foliosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal effects.
